# Hugues Clouâtre - AI & Platform Engineering

> AI and platform engineering insights from a Field CTO and AWS veteran. Practical guides for CTOs and engineering leaders.

## Tools

- [search_posts](https://clouatre.ca/search/): Search blog posts by keyword

## Agent Discovery

No account, no API key, no signup; paid endpoints settle per call via the x402 HTTP 402 protocol in USDC on Base.

- [API catalog](https://clouatre.ca/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset -- all machine-readable endpoints
- [Agent skills](https://clouatre.ca/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Available tools for AI agents
- [skill.md](https://clouatre.ca/skill.md): Agent skill description with frontmatter
- [WebMCP manifest](https://clouatre.ca/.well-known/webmcp.json): WebMCP tool manifest describing the browser-side document.modelContext tools
- [MCP server card](https://clouatre.ca/.well-known/mcp.json): Agent capability declaration
- [MCP live transport](https://clouatre.ca/mcp): MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint exposing resume_eval, agent_readiness, and btc_regime as tools (x402-paid, USDC on Base)
- [Agent card](https://clouatre.ca/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A-style agent card -- name, skills, capabilities
- [ARD manifest](https://clouatre.ca/.well-known/ard.json): Machine-readable capability entries for AI agents
- [Resume eval response schema](https://clouatre.ca/.well-known/resume-eval-response-schema.json): JSON Schema for the resume evaluation response and 402 payment challenge
- [OpenAPI spec](https://clouatre.ca/v1/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the x402 surfaces
- [x402 resource manifest](https://clouatre.ca/.well-known/x402): Machine-readable x402 resource advertisement (resource, price, network, discovery docs)
- [Paid evaluations on this origin](https://clouatre.ca/.well-known/x402): The paid AI evaluations (POST /v1/resume-eval, POST /v1/agent-readiness, GET /v1/btc-regime, POST /v1/judge, USDC on Base via x402) are live on clouatre.ca /v1/* URLs; operation and settlement run via aptu-dev-x402 upstream (https://aptu.dev)
- [RSS feed](https://clouatre.ca/rss.xml): Subscribe to new posts
- [Experiments feed](https://clouatre.ca/experiments.xml): RSS for bench experiment posts
- [Sitemap](https://clouatre.ca/sitemap-index.xml): Full site structure
- [Knowledge graph](https://clouatre.ca/knowledge-graph.json): Typed post graph -- clusters, citation edges, reading chains
- [OKF knowledge bundle](https://clouatre.ca/okf/index.md): Open Knowledge Format v0.3 bundle -- concepts derived from the knowledge graph, organized by cluster
- [Experiments index](https://clouatre.ca/experiments/): Bench experiment posts with committed protocol JSON

## Experiments

Data-first posts from the experiment bench; each carries the raw protocol JSON under /experiments/.

- [Screening-Gate Calibration: 33 Candidates, 0 Auto-Approvals](https://clouatre.ca/experiments/jev-screen-gate-calibration/): A calibration run retuned the bench screening gates: candidates scored 1.17-1.56 under the old rubric and 2.27-2.61 after; auto-approvals went 0 to 7.
- [How a Blind Metric Published a False AI Grounding Win](https://clouatre.ca/experiments/metric-blindspot-cost-roi-cluster/): A continuous-score run on the cost-roi cluster logged 2.0 vs 0.0 as a grounding win. Ground truth was 4 posts; both arms were wrong in 200 of 200 runs.
- [Structured Grounding Did Not Fix Reading-Chain Recall](https://clouatre.ca/experiments/structured-exhibit-grounding-reading-chains/): A sequence-match re-run scored exact reading-chain recall: 0/103 with KG grounding, 0/103 without (n=206). Grounding changed failure quality, not success.
## Blog Posts

- [Frontmatter to OKF: 61/63 Agent Score, One Source of Truth](https://clouatre.ca/posts/frontmatter-okf-knowledge-graph/): Frontmatter drives a pure pipeline to a knowledge graph and an OKF bundle; agents scored 61/63, llms.txt 55/63, whole bundle 31/63, per-question slice 22/63.
- [When Accuracy Misleads: Cost Matrix Metrics and Thresholds](https://clouatre.ca/posts/accuracy-cost-matrix-threshold/): When does accuracy mislead? A sealed, pre-registered SECOM evaluation: the top model by accuracy catches zero defects until the threshold matches costs.
- [Verifying x402 Endpoints: The 5-Check Buyer Recipe](https://clouatre.ca/posts/verify-x402-endpoints/): How to verify an x402 endpoint before you pay: 5 free or cheap checks, 4 of 4 hostile-seller failure modes detected, 1 of 3 live endpoints diverged.
- [Pay-Per-Call APIs: $0.005 Calls, Measured Treasury Costs](https://clouatre.ca/posts/pay-per-call-margins-treasury/): Sub-cent API calls clear the card fee floor and settle at request; measured USDC off-ramp sweeps show deterministic treasury costs for pay-per-call revenue.
- [x402 on Cloudflare Workers: AI Agents Pay Per Call in USDC](https://clouatre.ca/posts/agent-payments-x402/): AI agents pay per call in USDC on Base and Solana; no accounts, no API keys. The full HTTP 402 handshake, documented from a production deployment.
- [When Should an AI Agent Enumerate, and When Delegate?](https://clouatre.ca/posts/ai-agent-enumerate-or-delegate/): A sealed 240-call exhibit grounds the boundary between decision spaces an agent should enumerate exactly and those it should delegate to a typed judge.
- [Does WebMCP Pay Off for Content Sites?](https://clouatre.ca/posts/webmcp-beyond-checkout/): Across 135 agent runs on a production blog, shrinking a four-tool WebMCP surface yielded little median-token benefit; relevance ordering mattered more.
- [How Much Tool Documentation Do AI Agents Actually Need?](https://clouatre.ca/posts/mcp-tool-docs/): Trimming MCP tool-definition prose cut cold-call input tokens 12-14% with no statistically detectable accuracy loss across two model tiers.
- [Agent-Ready Websites: The 5-Layer Implementation Stack](https://clouatre.ca/posts/agent-ready-website/): Your website serves two audiences now: humans reading HTML and agents calling tools. Measure agent readiness across five layers and learn what to ship first.
- [AI SDLC Governance: Three Layers for Engineering Leaders](https://clouatre.ca/posts/ai-sdlc-governance-stack/): A three-layer governance stack (comprehension, review gate, and observability) gives engineering leaders measurable control over AI-generated code volume.
- [How Does Context Engineering Drive Multi-Agent Reliability?](https://clouatre.ca/posts/context-engineering-multi-agent-reliability/): Context engineering turns AI context into infrastructure, preventing the accumulation, starvation, and leakage failures that undermine multi-agent reliability.
- [Open-Weight LLMs Reach the Structured Output Quality Ceiling](https://clouatre.ca/posts/open-weights-structured-output-cost/): Open-weight models now match closed-source on structured output at 95x lower cost. Pre-registered blind eval, 30 samples, zero quality delta.
- [AI Approval Gates: Engineering Oversight at Machine Speed](https://clouatre.ca/posts/ai-approval-gates/): AI approval gates: reversibility-tiered human-in-the-loop design with four health metrics that prevent reviewer atrophy at machine speed.
- [AI Adoption in Engineering: Breaking the 50% Plateau](https://clouatre.ca/posts/ai-adoption-engineering/): Purpose-built AI tooling cuts per-task cost 21-68%. Three-cohort model and four-phase operating framework for engineering leaders past the 50% adoption plateau.
- [AI Delivery Decision Frameworks: Type 1, Type 2, DACI](https://clouatre.ca/posts/decision-frameworks-ai-delivery/): Misclassifying reversible decisions costs more than the decision itself. Four frameworks unblock AI delivery: Type 1/Type 2, Eisenhower, DACI, and PMBOK.
- [SRE for AI Agents: Error Budgets, Trust, and 90 Trials](https://clouatre.ca/posts/sre-ai-agents-production/): Can an AI agent predict scope without hallucinating? We ran 90 trials. It added 1.7 phantom files per change. Error budgets and trust ladders are the gate.
- [What a Null Result Taught Us About AI Agent Evaluation](https://clouatre.ca/posts/prompt-repetition-agent-evaluation/): We tested prompt repetition on 20 parallel AI agents. Ceiling effects dominated both experiments. The null result is a finding about evaluation design.
- [Why Your AI Agent Failed in Production](https://clouatre.ca/posts/ai-observability-gaps/): Why your AI agent failed: missing decision provenance, not metrics. The 3 observability gaps traditional monitoring won't catch.
- [RAG for Legacy Systems: 7,432 Pages to 3s Answers](https://clouatre.ca/posts/rag-legacy-systems/): 7,432 pages to 3-second answers. Production RAG for legacy systems with model-agnostic reranking. No vendor lock-in, validated across 4 LLM families.
- [AI Agents in Legacy Systems: ROI Without Modernization](https://clouatre.ca/posts/ai-agents-legacy-roi/): Layer AI agents over legacy systems without modernization. 30-80% productivity gains in 3-6 months. Patterns that bypass technical debt.
- [AI Supply Chain Attacks: New Vectors in Dependencies](https://clouatre.ca/posts/ai-supply-chain-attack-vectors/): Slopsquatting: attackers register packages AI hallucinates. XZ Utils showed the stakes. A framework to assess your AI supply chain exposure.
- [Orchestrating AI Agents: A Subagent Architecture](https://clouatre.ca/posts/orchestrating-ai-agents-subagent-architecture/): 50% cost reduction with subagent architecture for AI coding. Capable models for planning, fast models for building. Real metrics from a production skill.
- [AI-Augmented CI/CD: Shift Left Security With Bounded Risk](https://clouatre.ca/posts/ai-augmented-cicd/): AI code review in CI/CD with prompt injection containment. Defensive patterns: review-context profiles, managed review gates, capability isolation.
- [AI-Assisted Development: The Accountability Layer](https://clouatre.ca/posts/ai-assisted-development/): AI made writing code faster. Without governance controls, it makes reviewing and understanding code slower. The accountability layer is the structural response.
- [AI-Governed DNS Migration Without Maintenance Windows](https://clouatre.ca/posts/zero-downtime-dns-migration/): Programmatic pre-validation eliminates the weekend window from DNS migrations. Full platform migration: 2 hours, business hours, zero downtime.
